open_points.subject: rules.http_router_backend route count
open_points.text: State 4 says "the route table keeps 50 of the 56 routes of rules.http_router_backend", while State 2 says "rules.http_router_backend (56 routes)" is carried to the router closure.
open_points.question: Does the current rules.http_router_backend contain 50 routes after removing the six challenge routes, or does it still contain 56?
options: Replace the backend catalog with 50 routes
Keep 56 backend routes despite State 4 saying the six challenge routes are gone
open_points.default_guess: Use a 50-route backend catalog and remove all six challenge routes.

witness.initial: An assembler generates the HTTP router solely from the accepted states.
events: The assembler reads State 4 and removes the six staff-challenge routes.
The assembler reads State 2's carried backend declaration stating that rules.http_router_backend has 56 routes.
outcomes: The generated router has 50 routes and exposes no challenge endpoint.
The generated router has 56 routes, requiring six additional route definitions or preservation of the removed challenge endpoints.
witness.observer: An API client inspecting or calling the generated routes

open_points.subject: models module ownership after removal of M08–M12
open_points.text: State 1 says "The former models M08–M12 ... are removed", while State 3 says module:models owns "The State 1 records M01–M37".
open_points.question: Is M01–M37 meant as an inclusive set that still contains M08–M12, or as a numbered range with those five models absent?
options: Keep the numbering gaps and omit M08–M12
Retain M08–M12 as models owned by module:models
open_points.default_guess: Keep the numbering gaps and omit M08–M12 because the removal is explicit.

witness.initial: A later agent is generating the closed model catalog and module exports.
events: The agent reads the explicit removal of PasswordResetToken, EmailVerificationChallenge, PendingEmailChange, EmailDeliveryRecord and EmailDeliveryRequest.
The agent reads that module:models owns State 1 records M01–M37.
outcomes: The model catalog and exports omit M08–M12, leaving intentional numbering gaps.
The model catalog retains or recreates M08–M12 to satisfy the inclusive M01–M37 ownership statement.
witness.observer: Code importing the model catalog or inspecting its closed schemas
